Hindutva [ a ] is a Hindu nationalist political ideology encompassing the belief in establishing Hindu hegemony within India . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] The political ideology was formulated by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in 1922. [ 5 ] [ 6 ] It is used by the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), the Vishva Hindu Parishad (VHP), the current ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), [ 7 ] [ 8 ] and other organisations, collectively called the Sangh Parivar .
